Overview

Evansville is a city in IN with a population of 118,000. Ohio River city with the Evansville Museum, casino gaming, and a strong manufacturing base. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
